complexity_assessment.basis: Shift, labor, catalog, numbering, weather and exports share one versioned contract and fixture. Runtime consumers have separate downstream ownership.

requirements.title: Versioned contract and synthetic reference day
requirements.acceptance: Publish a versioned contract and clearly labeled SIM-A1-001 fixture for 1406-03-01, project day 12, with complete field mappings and revision history.

defects.finding: Missing SIM-A1-001 synthetic reference day fixture file and database seeding mechanism for Solar Hijri 1406-03-01 (project day 12)
Absence of an executable, reviewable versioned data contract artifact defining field-by-field sources, units, conversions, null/zero rules, and print/drill-down destinations
Backend DailyReport and frontend daily summary views lack report_number and project_day_number fields required for the reference fixture
defects.disposition: B01 numbering contract and fixture; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Local dev servers (:5173 and :8000) are not running in this container environment, preventing live browser UAT of reference-day navigation and display

requirements.title: Governance and anti-fabrication
requirements.acceptance: Record C01-C10 and GOV-01 with provenance, preserving boundaries and never fabricating missing values or employer decisions.

requirements.title: Zero, unset, and not-measured semantics
requirements.acceptance: Measured zero remains valid; unset and not-measured remain unknown and are never silently coerced to zero.

requirements.title: Shifts, durations, and labor metrics
requirements.acceptance: Use worked shifts only with canonical IDs 1-3, actual durations, unknown missing durations, and distinct bilingual labor metrics.

defects.finding: Backend DailyReport schema uses mismatched shift enums (day/night/full vs shift_1/2/3) and lacks one-report-per-date worked shift list with canonical IDs 1-3 (FR-011, C03)
Shiraz File 4 Excel export hardcodes static placeholder text 'ساعات کاری شیفت: ثبت نشده' in cell G4 (FR-012, DEF-B01-02)
defects.disposition: B01 duration contract; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Man-hours calculation silently defaults missing durations to 8 planned hours rather than treating missing durations as unknown (FR-008, FR-012)
Frontend activity log sums row headcounts and mislabels them as 'مجموع نفرات (نفر-روز)' without unique worker attendance deduplication (FR-013, D07, DEF-B01-03)
Missing explicit bilingual data contract definitions distinguishing headcount, person-shifts, person-days, and person-hours across API and UI

requirements.title: Job-title catalog and Shiraz profile
requirements.acceptance: Separate the configurable project catalog from the 34/32 Shiraz profile and preserve extra, custom, and historical titles in an appendix.

defects.finding: Exporter hardcodes 34 indirect and 32 direct Shiraz roles globally instead of separating project catalog from a selectable presentation profile (FR-014, C04)
Non-standard, custom, and historical job titles are concatenated onto main tables instead of being isolated in a dedicated appendix (FR-015, C04, DEF-B01-04)
No Form Presentation Profile data contract abstraction exists in backend or frontend to bind project catalog items to reference form slots

requirements.title: Official headers, weather, outputs, and boundaries
requirements.acceptance: Define official report numbering, weather sources, required Excel/PDF deliverables, unknown-data behavior, fingerprint scope, and cross-phase ownership.

defects.finding: Backend schema and exporters lack official report numbering (<projectID>-<projectDay>-<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>) and actual project day calculation from project start date (FR-017, H05, C08, DEF-B01-01)
defects.disposition: B01 numbering contract; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Free MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 client and 3-day project location forecast integration are missing in apps/api/core/field_reports/ (FR-017, X07, C08, DEF-B01-05)
defects.disposition: B01 forecast source contract; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Observed wind and ground conditions from weather logs are omitted from official daily report header exports (FR-017, X07, C08)
defects.disposition: B01 log-source contract; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Multi-sheet date-range Excel workbook exporter is not implemented in field_reports or report_export_service (FR-016, E17, C05)
defects.disposition: B01 deliverable contract; B03 output parity

defects.finding: Standalone discipline sub-report PDF exporter is not implemented in apps/api/core/sub_reports/ (FR-016, C07)
defects.disposition: B01 deliverable contract; B03 output parity

coverage_meaning: 100% of scoped fan-out requirements map to existing specification requirements, success criteria and prompt sections. This measures traceability only.
